name: ReflexAgent
description: Receives anomaly trigger. Makes tools call to GNN Inference Engine. Queries Spanner via MCP for entity domain metadata and impact radius. Performs domain triage. Publishes reflex.triage.ready to Detective Agent.

skills.name: GNN Inference Engine Integration
skills.description: Calls GNN Inference Engine with anomaly payload, retrieves anomalous subgraph, per-node anomaly scores, composite impact score, and ranked remediation branches.
examples: Receive anomalous subgraph with ranked branches

skills.name: Spanner Domain Triage
skills.description: Queries Spanner entity tables via MCP Toolbox or direct Spanner API to determine network domain (RAN/CORE/TRANSPORT/CROSS_DOMAIN), impact radius, and entity metadata for affected nodes. Maps GNN ranked branches to domain priority.

skills.name: Reflex Triage Event Publishing
skills.description: Publishes reflex.triage.ready event with 6 fields (entity_ids, anomalous_subgraph, ranked_list, domain_triage, priority_flag, priority) for Detective Agent consumption.
